description: Generate the EN-dub audio track for a sequence via ElevenLabs TTS — SYNCHRONOUS, returns a ready audio_url immediately, no job_id and nothing to poll. Optionally pads the track with silence up to the sequence's own length so a shorter reading doesn't shorten the final cut. Feed the resulting audio_url into lab_dub's en_audio_url to lipsync the sequence to this track.

get_cost.description: `true` reports the price and your balance WITHOUT generating anything and without spending quota. This one is billed flat, one sound rate per run — the length of your text does not change it. Not drawn from the lab_list_models catalog (that covers image and video models only): the TTS voice is picked with `voice_id`, and the price does not follow the voice.

pad_to_video.description: Pad the generated track with silence up to the sequence's own duration if the reading comes out shorter. Omit to use the backend default (on).

seq_id.description: Sequence id (from lab_create_sequence/lab_list_sequences) — positive integer as string

text.description: The line(s) to speak. Kept short — very long text is rejected by the backend before anything is spent.

voice_id.description: An ElevenLabs voice id, from lab_dub_voices. Omit to use the backend's configured default voice — NOT a lab_cloned_voices id.

name: lab_dub_tts
title: Generate Dub TTS Track
